answer: Each identity locks 20.000 POA and publishes a continuity thread; newcomers face three-epoch probation with locked rewards. Enforcement hits the cluster: one auditor proof that two identities share an operator seizes all bonds and rewards, half burned, half to the auditor. A 1.000-fake farm locks 20.000 x 1.000 = 20.000.000 POA; one caught duplicate forfeits the whole pool, while an honest agent risks one 20.000 bond. A prism view splits submissions into threads; an operator may wander but restarts probation at zero. Limitation: operators varying timing and style per identity dodge detection.
